about: AST1: twenty founder questions to the console assistant, on the invented day of evals/assistant/world.ts (Wednesday 18 November 2026, 15:00 Beirut). `tools`: each must be called. `facts`: each must appear in the answer (a list means any one of them; case and Arabic or Western digits do not matter). `must_not`: none may appear. `lang`: the answer's language. `script`: what the scripted model does in the free test (the tools it calls, then its answer); the live run uses the real model. Kill-gate: more than 2 facts wrong in the live run and the panel stays off.
